name: inbox.meta_forget
description: Deletes the comments and DMs that came through our own Meta app to the brand's Instagram account and Facebook Page, with the ids of the people who sent them: done when the brand disconnects Facebook, as Meta's Platform Terms ask (§3.d.i). Only an owner or admin of a company on the operator's list. Internal: packages/connect.
sql: with d as (delete from brandbase.inbox_messages m where m.brand_id = :brand and m.external is not null and m.platform in ('ig', 'fb') returning 1) select jsonb_build_object('deleted', (select count(*) from d)) as result
